newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC seen close to Oppenheimer deal.
newsitem.headline: CIBC seen close to Oppenheimer deal.

text.p: CIBC-Wood Gundy Inc, the brokerage arm of Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, is close to a takeover deal for privately owned Wall Street brokerage Oppenheimer & Co, according to market speculation and media reports on Wednesday.
Toronto Stock Exchange traders said talk of the deal had circulated in trading rooms for months.
"There's no question that they're talking and as someone said to me this morning, 'It's a matter of when, not if,'" said one trader who asked not to be identified.
"No comment," said Karyn Byrne, spokeswoman for CIBC-Wood Gundy Inc, when asked about the rumors.
Oppenheimer spokesman John Ryan told Reuters that the company did not comment on rumors.
Canada's Financial Post reported today that CIBC would likely pay between US$400 million and US$500 million for Oppenheimer, a specialist in arbitrage.
CIBC shares were up 0.90 to 37.55 in Toronto in second most active trading of almost 2.2 million shares.
